steps.text: Both tests pass. The fix replaces the `set()`-based implementation (which doesn't preserve order and fails on unhashable items like dicts) with a simple linear scan that keeps the first occurrence order and works with any item type, including unhashable ones like dicts. The `item not in result` check uses equality comparison rather than hashing, so it works for dicts and other unhashable types.
